design: User-approved bounded refinement, approximately 300–350 words; representation/safe text/partial results/completion.

decision.retain: Repeated reduction of concrete contract defects, transfer preservation and no material regression or unnecessary API/mechanism growth.
decision.revise: One narrow guidance failure justifies the single allowed correction and affected reruns.
decision.abandon: No demonstrated incremental benefit within the fixed budget, or unresolved regressions/costs.

controls: Existing build catalog held fixed across arms; error guidance absent/present. Reviewer arm-blinded; task/probes visible. Existing discovery cases are informed by historical failures, not unseen transfer.
prospective_reader_contract: Malformed data and read failure arriving together expose both causes; frozen before authors.

checklist.blind_review: complete; 8 sources, initial six frozen before supplemental two
checklist.decision_and_validation: complete; repository checks passed, integrity/seal recorded separately

disposition.decision: shelve standalone candidate; do not rewrite or promote
disposition.early_stop: All eight baseline candidates passed held contract probes; source review found no introduced contract defect. No concrete no-guidance failure to target.
disposition.inference: The bounded tasks do not establish incremental value for new runtime guidance. They do not prove universal ineffectiveness.
